You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0050.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

args.command:
python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
im=Image.open('mol_0050.png');print(im.size);im.crop((410,265,825,690)).resize((1245,1275)).save('zoom.png')
PY

python - <<'PY'

PY

from PIL import Image

PY

cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem,rdMolTransforms
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
from rdkit.Chem.rdchem import BondType, BondDir
# (name, elem, x, y) pixels, coordinates y up
atoms=[('L_CO','C',169,481),('L_carO','O',51,501),('L_O','O',226,380),('L_C','C',343,403),('L_H','H',281,320),('L_HO_C','C',356,521),('L_OH','O',350,630),('L_Me_C','C',249,574),('L_Me','C',208,684),('mid_OH_C','C',455,353),('mid_OH','O',427,272),('mid_C','C',533,443),('mid_Me','C',554,483),('core_C','C',476,547),('core_O','O',651,466),('core_EC','C',502,666),('core_EO','O',437,749),('core_EsterO','O',597,665),('side_C','C',596,547),('side_Me','C',576,511),('side_H','H',673,600),('side_CH2','C',715,522),('side_CH2_2','C',720,401),('tBu_C','C',855,430),('tBu_Me1','C',886,402),('tBu_Me2','C',889,451),('tBu_Me3','C',843,473),('upper_C','C',614,355),('upper_Me','C',672,382),('upper_HO_C','C',551,255),('upper_OH','O',494,162),('upper_EC','C',626,158),('upper_EO','O',592,57),('upper_EsterO','O',736,216),('upper_CH','C',730,325),('upper_H','H',841,323)]
# tBu substitution text is shorthand, atom x~855 arbitrary and methyls positions chosen artificial
bonds=[(0,1,2),(0,2,1),(0,7,1),(2,3,1),(3,4,1),(3,5,1),(3,9,1),(5,6,1),(5,7,1),(5,13,1),(7,8,1),(9,10,1),(9,11,1),(11,12,1),(11,13,1),(11,27,1),(13,14,1),(13,15,1),(15,16,2),(15,17,1),(17,18,1),(18,19,1),(18,20,1),(18,21,1),(21,22,1),(22,23,1),(23,24,1),(23,25,1),(23,26,1),(27,28,1),(27,29,1),(27,34,1),(29,30,1),(29,31,1),(31,32,2),(31,33,1),(33,34,1),(34,35,1),(34,14,1)]
# warning core_O bond C476 and upper_CH C729 yes
m=Chem.RWMol()
for n,el,x,y in atoms:
 a=Chem.Atom(el);a.SetProp('_TriposAtomName',n);m.AddAtom(a)
for i,j,b in bonds:m.AddBond(i,j, BondType.DOUBLE if b==2 else BondType.SINGLE)
m=m.GetMol();Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
conf=Chem.Conformer(len(atoms))
for i,(_,el,x,y) in enumerate(atoms):conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x*.0125,-y*.0125,0))
m.AddConformer(conf)
# wedge drawn outward from stereocenter, start=end = actual central atom on 2d figure
wedges=[(3,4,'dash'),(5,6,'dash'),(7,8,'dash'),(9,10,'dash'),(13,14,'wedge'),(18,20,'dash'),(29,30,'wedge'),(27,29,'dash'),(34,35,'dash'),(34,14,'wedge')]
for a,b,typ in wedges:
 bond=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(a,b)
 if bond.GetBeginAtomIdx()!=a:
  # RDKit direction follows beginning, reverse bond by remaking molecule if needed
  print('REVERSED',a,b,bond.GetBeginAtomIdx())
 bond.SetBondDir(BondDir.BEGINWEDGE if typ=='wedge' else BondDir.BEGINDASH)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') or a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED: print(a.GetIdx(), atoms[a.GetIdx()][0],str(a.GetChiralTag()),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?')
print('smiles:',Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m),isomericSmiles=True))
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=51677; params.maxIterations=500
cids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=32,params=params,numThreads=4)
print('embed:',len(cids), flush=True)
if not cids: raise Exception('embedding failed')
results=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m,numThreads=4,maxIters=600)
energies=[(en,idx,ok) for idx,(ok,en) in enumerate(results)]
print('best energies:',sorted(energies)[:8], flush=True)
idx=sorted(energies)[0][1]
cf=m.GetConformer(idx)
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(str(m.GetNumAtoms())+'\n3D reconstruction of mol_0050.png; MMFF94 optimized\n')
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  p=cf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()); f.write('%-2s %14.8f %14.8f %14.8f\n'%(a.GetSymbol(),p.x,p.y,p.z))
PY
python build.py
